original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target literally with target-selection.json/full_target and compared H001–H006 with problem.md:25–36: positive integer dimensions, joint smoothness, fixed unit q, unit constraint, pointwise existential normal acceleration and time-local uniform compact support are all retained. Natural-number dimension parameters represent exactly the original positive integers under H001; every positive integer has the unique identical natural-number dimension, and H001 still explicitly requires positivity. H003 (|q|=1) is present and unused; q's fixed value is used through H006, without inventing a use for its norm. The approved interpretation in problem.md:19–23 is preserved verbatim in full_target. D001–D014 give the coordinate spaces, Euclidean dot/norm, derivatives, Laplacian/Frobenius normalization and complete scalar expressions, with no theorem hidden as a definition. Their derivative operations use a total-zero convention only for notation; H002 proves the needed genuine regularity. D015 defines the actual finite E only after its N002 integrability guard; R004 and R006 directly take N002 whenever E is used or exported. The supplied proof route and calculations are retained: R001 proves tangency and also the explicit scalar/PDE consequence in problem.md:62–68; R002 proves common compact support and the finite-box absolute-integral bounds; R003 establishes both product identities and mixed derivative identification; R004 retains the MVT bound and punctured-quotient dominated-convergence limit; R005 uses coordinate FTC and Fubini with the measure identification explicitly justified, including n=1; R006 retains the two displayed integral equalities and zero-normal-term cancellation and the final constancy corollary. No material supplied passage was omitted. The 15 selected M contracts were compared with their successful pinned native probes and actual defining-file readbacks (M001 product rule; M002 symmetric second derivative including the real/complex-like minSmoothness convention; M003 continuous compact-support integrability; M004 filter DCT; M005 mean value bound; M006 FTC; M007 Fubini; M009 compact continuous bound; M010 box volume; M011 finite coordinate splitting; M012 finite integral sums; M013 integral addition; M014 scalar integral identity; M016 integral under measurable embedding; M017 singleton-product measure). Their general structures/typeclass premises are preserved in statements and obligations; all applications use the real/Lebesgue instances and justify their extra conditions. There is no imported literature E; Evans is provenance of the explicitly frozen exercise, not an imported theorem. H/E/M are the only roots, each N/P has exactly its displayed R producer, every selected M and internal N is in the AND closure of P, and no extra H was added. All six actual own conditional packets were inspected; unchanged R002 and R006 views were retained from candidate 4, and changed R001/R003/R004/R005 views were actually reread for candidate 6. This is same-author inspection, not Audit A.
